source_title: Stacking Up Every Assault Rifle in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 - GameRant
source_excerpt:
Assault rifles are the jacks of all trades in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 . They're effective at every engagement distance, and they can be built to specialize at fighting within certain ranges if players so choose to do so. There are eight ARs in MW4 as of the launch version, and if you want some insight as to which ones perform the best, here's a quick rundown covering each gun.
This ranked list is mainly based on ease of use. Every assault rifle in Modern Warfare 4 can compete fairly well when used in their intended engagement range, but the ones on the top of this list shine brighter than the others simply due to how much easier they are to use. The further down a gun is on this list, the higher its skill requirement.
The Han 86 in MW4 quickly became a fan-favorite weapon thanks to its high lethality at up to 30 meters, as well as its low recoil backed by a steady fire rate . This assault rifle is extremely competent, and it rewards players who can score kills early in their burst, as while the Han 86 doesn't kick as hard as other guns in MW4 , its recoil pattern sends its muzzle veering off harshly to the right on the tail-end of a mag dump.
The Han's Apex Attachment gives the weapon an airburst grenade launcher. Holding the fire button while using the launcher will change the distance at which its projectiles explode.
The classic M4 rifle returns as an ever-reliable weapon that's both easy to learn and to master. It doesn't hit as hard as the Han 86 (with the M4 requiring one more bullet to kill), but given its faster fire rate and recoil pattern that's much easier to control, the M4 still remains a competitive option for CoD MW4 multiplayer, especially if you make builds for it that lean heavily toward certain aspects like movement and ranged damage.
The M4's Apex Attachment converts it into an M4 Hurricane, turning it into a top-fed rifle that takes P90 magazines. Equipping this will improve the M4's handling, but reduce its damage and make its recoil worse.
The Axion performs very similarly to the Han and M4. It has the lethality of the former and the ease-of-use of the latter, and by default, it prevents enemy skulls from appearing on the enemy team's HUD if you take targets down with it. Simply enough, the Axion is a solid gun that's just as good as its user. It won't make things hard for you, but don't expect it to do anything fancy.
The Apex Attachment for the Axion replaces the weapon's pistol grip with a chainsaw grip, complete with a matching horizontal bar foregrip. Pair this with the 100-round mag attachment to turn the Axion into a close-quarters hipfire menace.
This is another returning classic that retains its reputation as a hard-hitting, but hard-kicking assault rifle. The Kastov 762 is powerful enough to put someone down with just three hits if one of your shots lands on their head , but such power comes at the cost of the gun having harsh recoil, both in terms of kick and pattern (the latter is almost purely diagonal). Still, if you're skilled enough to handle the Kastov 762, then it might as well be the best gun in the game.
The Kastov's Apex Attachment equips it with an experimental EMP barrel, which can be toggled to fire energy blasts that disable electronics, damage vehicles, and knock players away if they're close enough.
The Cronen Squall is designed for medium-long ranges. The combination of its stable recoil and relatively slow fire rate (673 RPM) makes it a prime candidate for long-range setups with long barrels and scopes, and it's not bad at close quarters either if you build it for speed. It's arguably the most comfortable to use among the hard-hitting assault rifles, and it would've outranked the Kastov if it didn't have a small base magazine of only 20 rounds.
The Cronen Squall's Apex Attachment is an underbarrel missile launcher. Projectiles fired from it can be steered mid-flight, giving you additional options for flushing out enemies camping in certain spots.
The Patriot is a step below the Kastov in terms of firepower — this rifle requires one additional bullet to kill compared to the Kastov, but since the Patriot's unique recoil pattern makes it kick vertically upward before leaning hard to the left, this weapon is a lot easier to control when firing short bursts, making it very good for holding medium-long sight lines . The Patriot's no slouch in CQB either, so don't be afraid to get up close and personal with it.
The Patriot's Apex Attachment gives the weapon an underbarrel taser that fires shotgun blasts of electric darts. The darts shock enemies, hampering movement and forcing them to fire their weapon uncontrollably.
This .50-cal rifle boasts the highest damage per shot value out of all assault rifles in MW4 , capable of three-shotting people to the upper chest and stomach, and two-shotting enemies to the head. However, the Oden's fire rate is also one of the slowest in the category, and while its muzzle doesn't climb as harshly as others, it still kicks like a mule. Because of these traits, this assault rifle feels more like a fully-automatic marksman rifle , so you'll have to adjust your playstyle accordingly if you want to get the most value out of the Oden.
The Oden's Apex Attachment turns it into a semi-automatic sniper rifle that can instantly kill targets if hit in the head, further cementing its identity as a long-ranged weapon. If you're close enough, it can one-shot enemies in the upper chest too.
As its name suggests, the Hyeon Burst is a burst-fire weapon, and if you've played older Call of Duty games , you probably already know what to expect from this thing. The Hyeon Burst is far from being a weak and terrible weapon , but it is leagues more punishing compared to the other assault rifles. However, if your aim is good , and if you can comfortably play around the Hyeon's one-burst-kill range , the Hyeon Burst becomes extremely powerful, enough to contend for the number one spot in the meta.
The Apex Attachment for the Hyeon Burst turns it into a fully-automatic weapon with a Hyperburst feature — its first three shots will fire near instantly, while subsequent rounds are fired at a much slower rate.
